targets.query:
from(bucket: "ur3e")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "stuck_joint.status" or r["_measurement"] == "robotarm.pt.state" or r["_measurement"] == "rt_model.dt.state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "joint_positions_3" or r["_field"] == "joint_positions_5")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
